info.title: API.SH: Tabelog
info.description: The Tabelog API from API.SH: public Tabelog data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The areas of a prefecture (or the sub-areas of an area) with their codes, for the area filter of /tabelog/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tabelog-areas

get.description:
Reviews of a Tabelog restaurant, 20 per page: id, link, reviewer name, profile link, reviewer's review and follower counts, each visit's meal (dinner/lunch), rating and spend per person, visit month, visit count, title, the review's opening lines and photos. Filter by meal and sort by visit date. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tabelog-reviews

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: standard (default), newest or oldest visit first.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Restaurants on Tabelog (English edition) for a prefecture, optionally an area and a genre, with a budget range and sort; 20 per page: id, name, link, rank, nearest station and distance, genres, rating, review count, dinner and lunch budgets, closed days, PR line, features (non-smoking, card accepted, multilingual menu...), award and Hyakumeiten flags and image, with the total. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (Tabelog shows up to 60 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tabelog-search

parameters.name: pref
parameters.description: Prefecture slug: tokyo (default), osaka, kyoto, hokkaido, fukuoka, kanagawa, aichi, hyogo, okinawa...

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Area code from Tabelog links: A1301 (Ginza, Shimbashi, Yurakucho), A1301/A130101, or A1301/A130101/R5266 (a station).

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre: sushi, ramen, yakiniku, tempura, izakaya, soba, udon, yakitori, unagi, tonkatsu, kaiseki, cafe... or a code like RC130101.

parameters.name: budget_min
parameters.description: Budget level from (Tabelog's levels 1-15: 1 = under JPY 1,000 ... 15 = JPY 100,000+).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
